quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #3
										  					
  

20 Questions • Passing Score 16

questions.question: What happens when you mix alcohol with drugs?

options.text: It decreases the effects of both.
It increases the effects of both.

questions.correctAnswerText: It increases the effects of both.
questions.explanation: Mixing alcohol and drugs increases the effects of both substances. Driving after using either one is unsafe. Mixing them together is even more dangerous.

questions.question: What is a sign of a drunk driver?
questions.explanation: Signs of drunk driving include weaving, driving slower than traffic, jerky movements, and sudden stops.

questions.question: What must you show during a traffic stop or equipment check?
questions.explanation: You must show your driver's license, proof of registration, and proof of insurance. You need all three documents when driving.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a green traffic light?

options.text: Keep driving unless vehicles or pedestrians are in the intersection.
Stop if a police officer is nearby.
Treat it like a four-way stop.
Come to a complete stop before going.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep driving unless vehicles or pedestrians are in the intersection.
questions.explanation: At a green light, let any pedestrians or vehicles in the intersection pass first. You can go, but be ready to slow down or stop if needed.

questions.question: What happens when drivers eat or drink while driving?

options.text: They have trouble controlling their vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: They have trouble controlling their vehicles.
questions.explanation: Eating, drinking, or smoking while driving is dangerous. These actions take your hands off the wheel and your eyes off the road. Drivers who do this have trouble staying in their lanes and controlling their vehicles.

questions.question: How can stress affect your driving?

options.text: It lowers your ability to focus on driving.
It decreases your chances of an accident.
It causes you to fall asleep at the wheel.
It makes you more aware of others around you.

questions.correctAnswerText: It lowers your ability to focus on driving.
questions.explanation: Strong emotions affect how well you drive. When you are worried, excited, afraid, angry, or sad, your driving suffers. Stress makes it harder to focus on the road. Wait until you feel calm before driving.

questions.question: When are seat belts most effective?

options.text: Only when the driver wears one.
Only for passengers on long drives.
Only on expressways for all occupants.
For all occupants every time the car is driven.

questions.correctAnswerText: For all occupants every time the car is driven.
questions.explanation: Everyone in the car should wear a seat belt every time you drive. In a crash, a person without a seat belt can become a flying object and injure others in the vehicle.

questions.question: What substances can impair your driving and result in a DUII arrest?
questions.explanation: Many substances can impair your driving. These include alcohol, illegal drugs, inhalants, and many legal medications (prescription and over-the-counter).

questions.question: What should you do when an emergency vehicle with flashing lights approaches?

options.text: Try to reach your destination before it catches up.
Keep driving but stay out of its way.
Pull to the side of the road and stop completely.
Stop in the middle of an intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull to the side of the road and stop completely.
questions.explanation: You must let emergency vehicles pass. Pull to the right edge of the road and stop. If you are in an intersection, drive through it first, then pull over.

questions.question: When should you give a hand or turn signal?

options.text: Only when there is traffic behind you.
Only when other traffic is nearby.

questions.explanation: Give a hand or turn signal at least 100 feet before you turn or change lanes. Use a longer distance when driving at high speed.

questions.question: You must signal before turning, changing lanes, or leaving a curb.

options.text: Only when other cars are nearby.
It is required by law and is a good habit.
Only during the move, not before.
Not needed if you move slowly.

questions.correctAnswerText: It is required by law and is a good habit.
questions.explanation: Signal at least 100 feet before you turn or change lanes. Always signal before leaving a curb. This tells other drivers what you plan to do.

questions.question: It starts to rain while you are driving. What should you do?

options.text: Drive close behind the car in front of you.

questions.explanation: Slow down when it rains. Turn on your headlights. If you cannot see the road clearly, pull over and wait.

questions.question: Smoking or getting ready to smoke while driving:
questions.explanation: Smoking while driving takes your hands off the wheel and your eyes off the road. This is dangerous.

questions.question: You are angry about something that happened at work. When you get to your car, what should you do?

options.text: Play loud music so you do not think about it.
Drive fast on the highway to release your anger.
Take a few minutes to calm down before driving.
Stop at a bar and have drinks before driving home.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to calm down before driving.
questions.explanation: Wait to calm down before you drive. Driving while upset or angry is dangerous. It puts you and others at risk.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: An orange sign with black letters means:
questions.explanation: Construction signs are orange with black letters. Drive carefully through work zones.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: A worker with a flag is ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you that left turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: The best way to avoid hydroplaning is to:

options.text: Keep your tires in good condition.
Slow down on wet or slushy roads.
Watch for puddles and standing water.

questions.explanation: Wet roads make it harder to stop and easier to skid. Do not use cruise control on wet or icy roads. Slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: At an intersection with no signs or lights, you arrive at the same time as a car to your right. What should you do?

options.text: Slow down and let the car on your right go first.
Drive into the intersection and make the other car stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let the car on your right go first.
questions.explanation: When two cars reach an uncontrolled intersection at the same time, the car on the right goes first. Wait for that car to pass safely.

questions.question: What happens when alcohol is mixed with another drug?

options.text: Only the alcohol effect becomes weaker.

questions.explanation: Mixing alcohol with another drug can make both effects stronger. For example, one drink plus cold medicine could feel like several drinks.
